basic_info.description: Rare 5-Unit Investment or Owner-User Opportunity with Panoramic Views in Corona Heights! This multi-family property offers significant upside with 4 of 5 units delivered vacant (1 tenant-occupied): 1 two-bedroom, 3 one-bedrooms, and 1 studio. Three units are gutted, presenting a blank canvas for developers or investors. Features include 4 levels of panoramic views, common backyard/deck, sprinkler system, 1-car garage, storage, separate utility meters, and below-ground 200 amp PG&E service. Potential for expansion or ADU addition. Located on a quiet street near the Castro, Cole Valley, Duboce Triangle, and Noe Valley, with easy access to tech shuttles, public transit, and local amenities. With solid bones and amazing views, this is an ideal value-add or redevelopment project, multi-generational compound, or income property. Being sold as-is; property may not qualify for conventional financing due to habitability status of 3 units. Tremendous opportunity for the right buyer in a prime San Francisco location.
